items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: Styled parts for an emoji picker and a reaction row that expands into it, with shortcodes, skin tones, custom emoji, and replaceable search, built on emoji-components.

items.name: emoji-picker-popover
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover
items.description: The emoji picker in your shadcn/ui popover, for the Base UI (default) and Radix bases. A trigger opens it, a pick closes it, and focus returns to the trigger. For --base aria, use emoji-picker-popover-react-aria.

items.name: emoji-picker-popover-react-aria
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover (React Aria)
items.description: The emoji picker in your shadcn/ui popover, for the React Aria base (--base aria). A trigger opens it, a pick closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: emoji-picker-popover-floating-ui
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover (Floating UI)
items.description: The emoji picker in a popover on Floating UI, without a shadcn/ui popover. A trigger opens it, a pick closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: emoji-reaction-bar
items.title: Emoji Reaction Bar
items.description: A row of reaction buttons on React Aria's useToolbar: the arrow keys move focus, Home and End go to the ends, and once focus is inside, the pointer carries it.

items.name: emoji-prosemirror
items.title: Emoji ProseMirror
items.description: Shortcode suggestions as a ProseMirror plugin, without React. It finds the :query, handles the keys, and replaces the query with the chosen emoji.

items.name: emoji-suggestions
items.title: Emoji Suggestions
items.description: The shortcode suggestions menu for what useEmojiSuggestions returns, at the caret on Floating UI. It never takes focus; the hook handles the keys. The Tiptap and Lexical items render it.

items.name: emoji-tiptap
items.title: Emoji Tiptap
items.description: Shortcode suggestions for a Tiptap 3 editor: the useTiptapEmojiSuggestions hook on the ProseMirror plugin, the EmojiSuggestionsMenu component, and an EmojiNode for custom emoji.

items.name: emoji-lexical
items.title: Emoji Lexical
items.description: Shortcode suggestions for a Lexical editor: the useLexicalEmojiSuggestions hook, the EmojiSuggestionsPlugin component, and an EmojiNode for custom emoji.
